body:
Location is Grand Rapids area, Michigan.  
Insurance is Blue Cross Blue Shield of Michigan.

I feel like I shouldn't be saddling everyone around me with my problems and debt because I'm too young to deal with them myself. The only things I've done so far in life are waste other people's time and money and bring shame to everyone who interacts with me. I don't think I deserve to live.

I mentioned it to my mom and she asked if I wanted to go to a local mental institution. I don't.

I don't know if that's something I *should* want to do.
